meta.title: Elchi Pochta — delivery service for e-commerce
meta.description: Elchi Pochta is a delivery service for online stores. We collect the order from you, deliver it to your customer anywhere in Uzbekistan, and show you every step.

hero.badge: A postal service built for e-commerce
hero.title: Your order reaches the customer on time
hero.subtitle: Elchi Pochta is a delivery service for online stores. We collect the order from you, deliver it to your customer anywhere in Uzbekistan, and show you every step.
hero.note: Parcels up to 1 kg within Tashkent — from 15,000 UZS

track.title: Track a parcel
track.subtitle: Enter the parcel ID and see its status.

band.caption: The Elchi Pochta team and sorting centre, Tashkent

delivery.title: Order delivery
delivery.body: We deliver to the customer's door, collect payment in cash or by card, and transfer the money to you.

pickup.title: Courier pickup
pickup.body: We collect parcels from your store or warehouse at an agreed time.

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.body: If the customer returns or exchanges an item, we bring it back to you free of charge.

calc.title: Calculate your delivery price
calc.subtitle: Enter the dimensions and weight — the price appears immediately.
calc.pickupOption: Have a courier collect it from me
calc.note: Volumetric weight = length × width × height ÷ 5000. The price is based on the greater of actual and volumetric weight.

one.title: You register the order
one.body: Enter the parcel details on the site or in the Telegram bot.

two.title: A courier collects it
two.body: The courier arrives at the agreed time and takes the parcel.

three.title: It passes the sorting centre
three.body: The parcel is sorted by route and sent on its way.

four.title: It reaches the customer
four.body: The courier collects payment while you watch the status in real time.

coverage.title: Across Uzbekistan, in four zones
coverage.subtitle: Every region belongs to a zone. The zone sets the price and the time.
coverage.zone3Regions: Samarkand, Bukhara, Navoiy, Jizzakh, Sirdaryo, Fergana, Andijan, Namangan, Kashkadarya

why.title: A small team paying close attention

know.title: We know every client
know.body: We are still small, so we work with each store personally and resolve issues within a day.

price.title: Transparent pricing
price.body: No hidden fees. The price the calculator shows is the price you pay.

responsibility.title: We take responsibility
responsibility.body: Every parcel is insured. If it is damaged, we cover the value of the goods.

telegram.title: Everything over Telegram
telegram.body: Booking, tracking and reports all happen inside the bot.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is there a minimum order volume?
faq.a1: No minimum. We accept your parcels even if there is only one a day.
faq.q2: Do you collect payment from the customer?
faq.a2: Yes. The courier accepts cash or card, and the money reaches your account in 1–2 business days.
faq.q3: How do I track a parcel?
faq.a3: Each parcel gets an ID. Check its status by ID on the site or in the bot.
faq.a4: Yes, with special packaging. Just mark the order as fragile when booking.
faq.a5: For ongoing partnership, yes. A one-off parcel needs no contract.

servicesPage.title: The full delivery cycle for an online store
servicesPage.subtitle: Take these services separately or together. Most stores start with the first two.

s1.title: Door-to-door delivery
s1.body: The courier hands the parcel to the customer. If nobody is home, we call and come back — at no extra cost.

s2.title: Cash-on-delivery collection
s2.body: We take the value of the goods from the customer in cash or by card and transfer it to you in 1–2 business days.

s3.title: Daily pickup
s3.body: At an agreed time the courier visits your store and takes the day's parcels in one go.

s4.title: Packaging
s4.body: We pack in cardboard, bubble wrap and tape, with extra protection for fragile goods.

s5.title: Returns handling
s5.body: We hold refused parcels for a few days, then return them to you or forward them elsewhere.

s6.title: Insurance
s6.body: Every parcel is insured by default. For high-value goods, extra cover costs 1% of the declared value.

pricingPage.title: Rates and additional services
pricingPage.subtitle: All prices are for parcels up to 1 kg. Above that, a surcharge applies per additional kilogram.
pricingPage.partnerText: Sending more than 300 parcels a month earns a separate contract rate.

partnersPage.title: We connect your store within a week
partnersPage.subtitle: From agreement to first parcel usually takes 3–5 business days.

p1.title: You leave a request
p1.body: A manager calls within a day to confirm volumes and destinations.

p2.title: We agree the price
p2.body: The rate is set by how many parcels you send monthly.

p3.title: The contract is signed
p3.body: Documents are signed online, and the warehouse and pickup time are fixed.

p4.title: The first parcel goes out
p4.body: You get a personal manager and a Telegram bot.

contact.title: Would you like a quote for your store?
contact.subtitle: We call within a day and quote a price based on how many parcels you send each month.
